description: Reverse reference lookup: find chunks whose text CITES a given legal norm ('Art. 395 CRR', '§ 25a KWG', 'Art. 28 DORA') — useful when a provision applies to an entity via a reference or range list that neither search_context nor lookup_exact surfaces. Optional query soft-ranks many citing chunks by semantic similarity. Same result format as search_context.

document_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these documents (ids from list_documents); they must belong to the given contexts.

norm.description: A single citation, e.g. 'Art. 395 CRR' or '§ 25a KWG'.

query.description: Optional natural-language focus to soft-rank many citing chunks by.

name: find_citing_chunks
